title: Clinically Interpretable Biological Age Estimation Using CatBoost and SHAP with Continuous and Categorical Features from NHANES
abstract: arXiv:2610.20868v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Biological age (BA) captures inter-individual variation in physiological aging beyond chronological age (CA). Although machine-learning models have advanced BA estimation, many rely primarily on continuous laboratory biomarkers, and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) dependence plots are typically interpreted visually. We developed a clinically interpretable machine-learning framework for BA estimation using heterogeneous clinical data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES 2011-March 2020, N = 24,983 adults aged >= 18). A CatBoost regression model incorporated 44 demographic, laboratory, physical examination, and lifestyle predictors to estimate CA, defining model-estimated age as BA. SHAP provided multi-level interpretability. translated_title: 基于CatBoost与SHAP、融合NHANES连续型与分类型特征的临床可解释生物学年龄估计
translated_abstract: 生物学年龄（BA）捕捉了超越实际年龄（CA）的个体间生理衰老差异。尽管机器学习模型已推动了生物学年龄估计的发展，但许多模型主要依赖连续型的实验室生物标志物，且SHapley加性解释（SHAP）依赖图通常仅通过目视方式进行解读。我们利用来自美国国家健康与营养调查（NHANES 2011-2020年3月，共24,983名18岁及以上成年人）的异质性临床数据，开发了一个临床可解释的生物学年龄估计机器学习框架。该CatBoost回归模型纳入了44个人口统计学、实验室检测、体格检查和生活方式预测变量来估计实际年龄，并将模型估计的年龄定义为生物学年龄。SHAP提供了多层次的可解释性。至关重要的是，在标准目视检查的基础上，我们直接在SHAP依赖图上实施了一个预先设定的自动化程序，以量化与……相关的特征值范围（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究基于NHANES数据构建了融合44个连续型与分类型临床特征的CatBoost生物学年龄估计模型，并通过SHAP实现了多层次临床可解释性，创新点在于提出在SHAP依赖图上自动化量化与衰老相关的特征值范围的方法。
en_tdlr: This study developed a clinically interpretable CatBoost-based biological age estimation framework using 44 continuous and categorical NHANES clinical features, and innovatively implemented an automated SHAP dependence-plot procedure to quantify feature-value ranges associated with aging.
